notes.title: Relase notes
notes.notes:
Fixes a problem with weekly tournament not updating to right tournament data if week changes while in a session.
Fixes a problem where closing or pausing while reshuffling could cause game to have mismatched tiles.

Thanks for continuing to play Mahjong Deluxe!

notes.title: Notes for update
notes.notes:
Added in 126 new unique classic puzzle layouts.
Added in 126 new speed level puzzle layouts.
This gives a total of 252 new levels to play!

We hope you enjoy Mahjong Deluxe!
